description:
Cast Dance of Many by paying {U}{U}.
Dance of Many enters the battlefield, creating a token copy of Moorland Rescuer.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the Moorland Rescuer token.
The Moorland Rescuer token dies, triggering itself and Dance of Many.
Resolve Dance of Many's trigger, sacrificing it.
Dance of Many leaves the battlefield, exiling nothing.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Archon of Falling Stars.
Archon of Falling Stars dies, returning Dance of Many to the battlefield.
Dance of Many enters the battlefield, creating another token copy of Moorland Rescuer.
Let one Altar of Dementia trigger resolve, causing a player to mill four cards.
Let the Moorland Rescuer token's trigger from step 4 resolve, returning Archon of Falling Stars to the battlefield.
Let the remaining Altar of Dementia trigger resolve, causing the targeted player to mill four cards.
Repeat from step 2.
